label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
raw_output: When a business collects customer data from third parties, they must inform the customer about how long the data will be kept, the reasons for processing, and the customer’s rights to access, correct, or delete their data. This applies when handling customer data during data collection or when sharing it with third parties.
